calls.statement:
SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc, f.store_key, f.product_key, f.channel_code, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.staff_purchase_flag, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id = 131 AND p.sku = 101624 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-26' AND DATE '2026-10-06'
ORDER BY f.sale_date, f.sale_ts_utc

WITH fct AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.net_amount) AS net_before_returns, sum(f.quantity) AS units
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name, r.receipts, r.units_sold, r.net_sales_before_returns, f.lines, f.dist_lines, f.units, f.net_before_returns
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=131
LEFT JOIN fct f ON f.sale_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' ORDER BY 1

SELECT r.return_date, r.sales_line_id, r.quantity_returned, f.sale_date
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=131 AND p.sku=101624 AND (r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04' OR f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-04')
